caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden table placed centrally against a plain, light-colored background. The table has an oval-shaped top that is dark brown in color with visible wood grain texture. The table's legs are made of thick wooden panels, cut with a curving design, and are also dark brown. There is a horizontal support connecting the two legs, which has a similar dark finish. The bases of the legs are flat and broad, providing stability, and the lower portion of the table includes a joint or hinge, suggesting part of the table might be extendable or foldable. There are no other objects or decorations in the drawing, and the table is the sole subject.
title: Dining Room Table
